title: Fix the Rocket Blind, Deaf and Mute
competitors: Blind, Mute and Deaf | 3 player obby – 20.2M visits, 1K all-time peak CCU (May 2026), 574 live – rowatcher/robloxgames.org 2026
demand_check: verified: BOMBANANA #1 most-played demo of June 2026 Next Fest (670K+ players at fest, 6M demo players by Aug), 1M wishlists, 21,294 Steam peak CCU Sep 4 2026 (univers-simu, gamespress, bombanana.net)
red_flags: needs exactly 3 players, no bot fallback for sensory roles; party round game = low monetization; disability-role framing could draw sensitivity complaints
why: Demand is real and fresh, but the exact blind/deaf/mute role split is already live on Roblox (20.2M visits) and party co-op monetizes poorly.
pivot: Keep the sensory-role defusal but add a solo/duo matchmaking fallback plus persistent collectible monkey crew and module-kit progression so it earns beyond cosmetics and does not clash with the obby.

title: Bust the Nodes
competitors: No Nodebuster-style cursor-burst game found on Roblox; adjacent upgrade-tree incrementals: Upgrade Tree: Elemental – 3.17M plays (created Jan 29 2026) – rolimons; Generic Upgrade Tree Incremental, Upgrade Tree Incremental, Everything Incremental – counts not shown – roblox.com 2026
demand_check: verified: Nodebuster 97% positive of 10,642 Steam reviews (search snippet); SteamSpy owner band from evidence not seen by me

title: Ripen the Server Banana
competitors: Banana Smash – 'Best Banana Clicker', UGC rewards, counts not shown; Click a Banana! (free UGC); banana by Kirtyx; Banana Clicker (Jun 2024) – roblox.com/creatorexchange, dates 2024-2026; none found with a shared server banana goal
demand_check: refuted: Steam Banana (Jun 2024) peaked ~850K CCU but dev said only ~141K were real, the rest bots farming real-money skin drops; fell to ~100K by Nov 2024 (Forbes, Polygon via Yahoo, mte.cc)
red_flags: source hype was bot-driven real-money skin trading, which Roblox cannot replicate; tapping-only loop is thin
why: The Steam 'phenomenon' was bot-inflated cash farming, banana clickers already exist on Roblox as UGC bait, and a shared tap goal alone is too thin to retain.
